title: commitwork annotation store
description: Human judgments over findings, applied AS-OF each slice's generated time. Had no schema until 2026-08-23. The `determination` object is the Phase-3 extension of evaluations/PLAN-vex-determination-matrix-2026-08-22.md: it does NOT replace `action`, which is the lifecycle verdict, but records the STRUCTURED REASON behind it. Every determination it carries was already being written in `reason` as prose — one live entry says 'requires per-property @JsonIgnoreProperties usage pattern not present in these services' (unreachable by configuration) and 'no fixed release available at acceptance time' (no fix upstream), which is two axes of the model in a sentence nothing can read.

repo.description: Omitted = wildcard, which once suppressed a CVE fleet-wide (see the store's own comment). Prefer naming it.

determination.description: The structured why. Axes are INDEPENDENT and all optional — an operator states what they actually determined and nothing else. An axis left out is `unknown`, which is a real state and never an absence. Values are validated against cra/determination.mjs, and a reachability or exploitability claim is REFUSED without evidence carrying a matching method (the Phase-4 gate).

evidence.description: What supports the claim. Without a matching method the reachability/exploitability axes degrade to unknown rather than being published.
